notes.title: PartySaur Demo Update #2
notes.content:
Hey y'all, we have a new update for our demo! We've tweaked some things and given a bit of a "facelift" to a bunch of stuff (things are looking gorgeous if I do say so myself). Anyway, here's a list of the things we changed:

Patch Changes:

[b]VISUAL UPDATES[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Treasure Bridge[/b]
[list]
[*]   Changes to foliage placement and appearance
[*]   Adjustments to water visuals
[*]   Minor tweaks to animations of the dice and the player
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]TipTapTrike[/b]
[list]
[*]   Revised look and feel of the scene and "MechA Trikes"
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]Eruption[/b]
[list]
[*]   Added a new stage
[/list]
[/list]
[b]ITEMS SYSTEM[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted chances of obtaining specific items based on each player's position on the board. These was an issue that happened on the background and didn't critically affect gameplay, but could be troublesome in the long run.
[/list]
As always, on behalf of everyone at DireGrin, we thank you for giving our game a try and hope to see you on Early Access. Remember, we are always listening to your feedback.

That's it for now. Bye y'all,
Seb.

notes.title: Steam Remote Play Together Festival!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450841/33190c0ce44092b75d612187d2751725eb6b908c.png[/img]

[h3]Be part of the festival with your friends![/h3]

We are excited to announce that [b]PartySaur: Dino Mayhem![/b] will be participating in the [b]Steam Remote Play Together Festival from February 12 to 19[/b]. It's a unique opportunity to enjoy prehistoric fun with your friends and find out who will be the king of the dinosaurs!

[h3]Dino updates! [/h3]

But that's not all, we have released new updates to the demo to make the experience even more exciting! Now you can enjoy PartySaur with your friends with significant improvements in gameplay and performance.

If you want to know more about these changes and what they have in store for you and your friends, feel free to check out the "[i]Updates[/i]" section! Get ready for an even more exciting gaming experience with [b]PartySaur: Dino Mayhem![/b]

As always, we appreciate the immense support and feedback you send us! We invite you to be part of our community on Discord and participate in each new delivery that we will bring you. <3

[url=https://discord.gg/4vqRMuwm6j][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450841/605b2f6f86893a6016433e727c7a4d0738cf0d72.png[/img][/url]

[b]See you at the festival![/b]

notes.title: PartySaur Demo Update
notes.content:
Hey there! This is our first update for our Demo (Hooraay). We thank you for playing and hope you are all enjoying our game.

Patch Changes:

[b]LOCALIZATION[/b]
[list]
[*] Added options for text to be displayed in either English or Spanish (More languages coming at a later date).
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new input displays for clearer instructions for keyboard players.
[/list]
[b]VISUAL UPDATES[/b]
[list]
[*] Made some changes to scenery and illumination (Go ahead and try to spot them).
[/list]

We again thank you for the support and hope you have a great time playing with our Dino friends. We eagerly await your feedback.

As we progress in our development process, we may continue to update this demo, with our ultimate goal being a better experience for all our players.

notes.title: PartySaur: Dino Mayhem on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that we have successfully reached our Kickstarter goal for PartySaur: Dino Mayhem! Thanks to your incredible support, we will be able to bring this casual multiplayer action game to more players around the world.

[h3][b]What does this mean?[/b][/h3]

PartySaur: Dino Mayhem will be closer!
You will be able to play with friends and family in exciting minigames set in a Jurassic world.
There will be new characters, minigames, and much more.
You will be part of a vibrant community of players who love dinosaurs and fun.

[url=https://discord.gg/4vqRMuwm6j][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450841/605b2f6f86893a6016433e727c7a4d0738cf0d72.png[/img][/url]

[h3][b]Do you want to know more?[/b][/h3]

Visit our Kickstarter page: [[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/diregrinstudio/partysaur-dino-mayhem-0?ref=discovery]Kickstarter Campaign[/url]
Join our Discord server: [url=https://discord.gg/4vqRMuwm6j]Discord Community[/url]
Follow us on Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/diregrin]Twitter[/url]
Or follow any of our social networks: [url=https://allmylinks.com/diregrin]Our social medias[/url]

Thank you again for your support! We can't wait to share PartySaur: Dino Mayhem with you.

Get ready for some Jurassic fun!
